title: Junior Selection Committee Meets for Key Decisions
indian_angle: This report details the latest administrative decisions impacting India's junior badminton talent pool.
summary: The Badminton Association of India's Junior Selection Committee convened today to discuss crucial matters regarding player selections and development pathways.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee for Player Representation
indian_angle: The establishment of this committee ensures Indian badminton players have a formal voice in the sport's governance and decision-making.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aimed at providing a platform for players to contribute to the sport's development.

title: Junior World Championships Camp Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's top young talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: India's national junior badminton squad has gathered at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati for an intensive coaching camp ahead of the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Advanced Coaches Course Concludes in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course enhances the coaching standards across India, directly impacting the development of future Indian badminton players.
summary: The BAI Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course, held across National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, concluded recently, upskilling coaches nationwide.

title: India Prepares for Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships
indian_angle: This camp is vital for nurturing young Indian talent for regional junior championships, a stepping stone to international success.
summary: The Indian junior badminton team is undergoing a rigorous coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Junior Domestic Events
indian_angle: This significant rule change will impact how junior domestic tournaments are played and strategized across India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of a new 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
